meta.skip_reason: Services offline — static-only mode; no performance or chaos reports generated

escalations.title: Arbitrary code execution (RCE) in protobufjs — orchestrator infrastructure
escalations.description: Remote code execution via protobuf parsing. Code injection through bytes field defaults in generated toObject code. Affects the core agent orchestration infrastructure.

escalations.title: JavaScript injection via AST type confusion in handlebars
escalations.description: 8 distinct CVEs in handlebars 4.x line. Arbitrary JavaScript execution via AST type confusion, @partial-block tampering, and dynamic partial injection.
escalations.fix: npm update handlebars (to 4.7.9+) in Source/Backend and portal/Backend

escalations.title: Arbitrary file read and RCE when Vitest UI server is listening
escalations.description: Vitest UI server lacks authentication — unauthenticated RCE and file disclosure when dev server is accessible. High risk in CI/CD if dev server is exposed.
escalations.fix: npm install vitest@3.2.6+ in Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend

p1_findings.title: /api/search route not wired — tests explicitly document it will FAIL
p1_findings.detail: FR-dependency-search requires GET /api/search in Source/Backend. Test file search.test.ts opens with a comment that the route is NOT wired and tests WILL FAIL. The traceability enforcer falsely reports PASSED. Route exists in portal/Backend but not Source/Backend.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Any CI run that includes search.test.ts will fail. End-to-end dependency typeahead is broken for Source/Backend consumers.
p1_findings.impact: Broken feature. FR-dependency-search acceptance criterion unmet.
p1_findings.recommendation: Implement GET /api/search in Source/Backend/src/routes/ and register in app.ts, or explicitly remove the test if this backend is out of scope.

p2_findings.title: Route handlers call store directly — service layer bypassed
p2_findings.detail: Both route files call store.* directly (findAll, findById, createWorkItem, updateWorkItem, softDelete). Violates CLAUDE.md: 'No direct DB calls from route handlers — use the service layer.'
p2_findings.recommendation: Extract store access into workItemService.ts. Routes call service; service calls store.

p2_findings.title: FR-TMP-001–010 (Tiered Merge Pipeline) — 0% implemented
p2_findings.detail: 10 FRs covering risk classification, Playwright E2E test generation, live E2E runner, auto-PR, AI PR review, risk-tiered auto-merge, config env vars, worker prerequisites, run JSON extensions, error handling. None implemented in Source/, portal/, or platform/.
p2_findings.recommendation: Open a plan to implement starting with FR-TMP-001 (risk classification), or explicitly mark spec as deferred/future-scope.

p2_findings.title: blocked_by missing from UpdateBugInput/UpdateFRInput — forces as any cast
p2_findings.detail: FR-dependency-api-types requires blocked_by?: string[] on UpdateBugInput and UpdateFeatureRequestInput. Missing field forces DependencyPicker.tsx to use as any casts (lines 291, 293). Breaks shared-type rule and loses TypeScript type safety on PATCH body.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add blocked_by?: string[] to both interfaces in portal/Shared/api.ts, then remove as any casts.

p2_findings.title: dependencyService imports bare pino logger — OTel trace context lost in dependency ops
p2_findings.detail: Two logger impls coexist. dependencyService.ts imports from ../logger (bare pino, no OTel) instead of ../lib/logger (full OTel). Dependency operations (add, remove, cycle detection, cascade dispatch) emit no trace_id or span_id — violates FR-021.
p2_findings.recommendation: Change import in dependencyService.ts line 10 to ../lib/logger. Delete portal/Backend/src/logger.ts.

p2_findings.title: Traceability enforcer blind to portal/ and FR-TMP-* — reports false PASSED
p2_findings.detail: Enforcer scans only Source/ and only the most-recent Plans/*/requirements.md. portal/ (86 FRs) and Specifications/tiered-merge-pipeline.md (FR-TMP-*) are never evaluated. Reports PASSED while FR-TMP-001-010 have 0% coverage.
p2_findings.recommendation: Extend enforcer to scan portal/ and accept Specifications/*.md directly as requirement sources. Solo-session only (tools/ is solo-session territory).

p2_findings.title: gRPC server crash via malformed request in @grpc/grpc-js
vite: server.fs.deny bypass on Windows via alternate paths
p2_findings.fix: npm install vite@8.0.16+ in Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend

p2_findings.title: react-router open redirect via protocol-relative URL reinterpretation
CRLF injection in form-data via unescaped multipart field names

p3_findings.title: FR-dependency-seed: seed.ts not implemented — BUG-0010 acceptance criterion unmet
p3_findings.recommendation: Create portal/Backend/src/database/seed.ts and call from index.ts after schema init.

p3_findings.title: DependencySection and BlockedBadge tests missing in portal/Frontend/tests/
p3_findings.recommendation: Add DependencySection.test.tsx and BlockedBadge.test.tsx with correct traceability comments.

p3_findings.title: FR-070–095 implemented without spec entries (scope creep)
p3_findings.recommendation: Back-fill spec entries for FR-070–095 or create new spec file (e.g., Specifications/image-upload.md).

p3_findings.title: Two eslint-disable exhaustive-deps suppressions in dependency feature
p3_findings.recommendation: Refactor to satisfy react-hooks/exhaustive-deps correctly (useCallback with correct deps or useRef for stable references).

p4_findings.title: Hardcoded fallback URL localhost:4200 in DebugPortalPage
p4_findings.recommendation: Remove hardcoded fallback or make it a build-time constant with a warning log when env var is absent.
